canon.title: Transformational Intelligence: Learning to Change the Game
canon.reading_route: Actual tracked PDF extracted with Poppler pdftotext -layout; primary text and method/limitation sections inspected, plus TI TeX
canon.summary: Formulation is an editable means under a fixed authorized intent charter. A transformation needs an executable construction, a bridge to the intended outcome, mechanism-discriminating evidence, and full lifecycle accounting. Its exact causal model proves passive observation cannot exceed 50% while an intervention policy reaches 8191/8192 with at most twelve queries; an unrestricted optimal planner matches it. The paper explicitly does not establish autonomous formulation discovery, an LLM achievement, or general creativity.
canon.campaign_application: Use equal permissions, strong unrestricted comparators and targeted removal. Freeze confirmation before assessment; keep evaluator changes in a separately justified epoch. Reuse carries scope and failure conditions, not authority.

canon.title: Out-Evolve: Building the Means of Discovery and Production
canon.reading_route: Actual tracked PDF extracted with Poppler pdftotext -layout; primary text and method/limitation sections inspected, plus TI TeX
canon.summary: Construct a useful system for which a simpler model is true. Its declared exact-query comparison changes 20 binary controls from an arbitrary 2^20 response family to 211 degree-at-most-two coefficients; a compatible 21st control needs 21 new calibrations. Those counts require qualified structure, preserved purpose and precision; calibration fit does not prove absent higher-order interactions. Reopened shear composition uses eight actions versus ten sealed, while unrestricted synthesis also uses eight. Measurement architecture can improve technical cost yet fail stable recovery.
canon.campaign_application: A capability must create useful new operating possibilities, not merely cache prior results. Construct its validity conditions; include equal-access conventional controls, complete discovery/construction/qualification costs, and fresh successor tasks. Industrial production and actual commercial adoption remain proposed, not demonstrated.

canon.title: Invent the Economy: Transformational Intelligence for Creating Viable Markets
canon.reading_route: Actual tracked PDF extracted with Poppler pdftotext -layout; primary text and method/limitation sections inspected, plus TI TeX
canon.summary: Treat the technical capability, beneficiaries, transfers, rights and finance schedule as a joint possibility. The exact model has four hypothetical buyers, 80% common qualification probability, $120,000 expected contribution, $300,000 successful contribution and $900,000 prefunding. A $40,000 per-delivery route cost reverses expected gain. These are supplied conditional numbers, not measured customers or a discovered market. The 2240-case checker establishes internal decision consistency.
canon.campaign_application: Keep technical correctness, participant benefit, profitability, liquidity and realized exchange separate. A profitable later project can remain unfundable from earned surplus. Recompute competing alternatives when technology changes them. Outcome pricing can align with eliminating unnecessary work, but competition and participation still determine capture.

canon.title: Transformational Autonomous Enterprises: Mission-Relative Revalidation for Capability Inheritance Across Four Execution Systems
canon.reading_route: Actual tracked PDF extracted with Poppler pdftotext -layout; primary text and method/limitation sections inspected, plus TI TeX
canon.summary: Evaluator-owned reuse of content-bound generic checks preserves fresh mission-specific input/output checking and separate authority. Weighted bill-of-materials demand and Boolean unique remediation impact share graph structure but require distinct algebra. All 40 valid tasks and eight invalid requests are correctly classified by reuse, full replay and the direct specialist. Generic cases fall 1600 to 64; total counted reference work falls 88.85%. The direct specialist has fewer events and lower pooled CPU, and wins final median wall time.
canon.campaign_application: Reuse complete dependency identities only; descendants start with currentProof:null and authority:[]. Retain original scored source and separately identify repaired-source confirmation. Existing four-source APIs and local EVM runs are useful reusable infrastructure but do not establish installed host qualification, demand, full monetary costs, or commercial profit.

frontier.status: public research artifacts; producing model unreleased
frontier.summary: Repository reports 721 manuscripts across 373 families, varied verification, and about 42% top-line formalization at retrieval. An unnamed internal model generated most results with an average three hours thinking compute per result, after about 4000 posed problems. Authors classify outputs as raw research data and warn unformalized results may have issues.
frontier.accessible: Public manuscripts, Lean artifacts, reasoning summaries and source history can be inspected and selectively checked.
frontier.conditional: No access to the internal model; no inferred ability to reproduce all results using available production models. Catalogue and verification status may change.

frontier.status: vendor research announcement with selected released artifacts
frontier.summary: OpenAI announces results in local smoothing/Kakeya, ETH refutation, and quantum field theory, emphasizing raw AI output and independent academic understanding. Math and computer-science natural-language and Lean materials are linked publicly; the physics collaboration withheld materials for its own write-up. Article dates the math output Oct18/formalization Oct19 and ETH output Oct16/formalization Oct17.
frontier.accessible: Inspect released math/CS artifacts and formal challenge statements.
frontier.conditional: This campaign has not rerun those proofs or established scientific correctness, precedence, practical algorithm speedups or availability of the discovery model. Formal statement alignment remains distinct from proof checking.

frontier.status: public model launch; production access subject to plan/account
frontier.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra is announced for ChatGPT Work/Codex and API as gpt-6.1-terra. Standard API rates are USD1 per million input, USD0.05 cached input, USD5 output tokens. Vendor evaluations report stronger visual computer use, software construction and scientific terminal work at reduced cost; the page recommends Sol/Astra for the most complex coding. Benchmark performance is task- and effort-specific.
frontier.accessible: Public API model and current Work/Codex availability are claimed in official sources. This campaign may use only currently enabled tools; a public model name does not grant API credentials or spending authority.
frontier.conditional: No autonomous service acceptance rate follows from vendor benchmarks. Measure retries, checks, failures, tool context and all resources on equivalent delivered work.

frontier.summary: Official pricing is USD2 per million input, USD0.10 cached input and USD10 output tokens. Vendor evaluations cover agentic coding, computer use and scientific work; scientific terminal-work average cost is reported as USD5.47 per task at maximum effort. The page states research/API evaluation setups can differ from production ChatGPT in prompts, tools and efforts.
frontier.accessible: Current enabled session model/tool system can perform research and engineering. API prices support modeled resource costs where exact metering is absent.
frontier.conditional: Do not use benchmark average task cost as the measured cost of this campaign. Hidden inference, orchestration, repeated context and unavailable token meter leave actual cost unknown.

frontier.summary: Google announces general availability of AlphaEvolve on Google Cloud. Its workflow provides baseline code, context and a deterministic evaluator; a client runner receives candidate mutations, compiles/tests/scores them and returns results. This establishes an accessible category of agentic algorithm search, subject to account, quotas and charges, rather than access already present here.
frontier.accessible: Public documentation and examples are inspectable.
frontier.conditional: No AlphaEvolve run is executed or assumed by this campaign. Vendor case studies do not establish matched-scope price, acceptance or cost for our offering.

frontier.summary: Inputs are functionally correct code requiring optimization against user-defined global criteria. Documentation distinguishes algorithmic discovery from basic code generation or linting and says established exact algorithms likely outperform AlphaEvolve on convex optimization. It can augment classical solvers and explore irregular or semantic design spaces.
frontier.accessible: Code/evaluator interfaces and solver guidance inform comparator design.
frontier.conditional: A normal optimizer remains a mandatory serious alternative; evolutionary search should be used only where measured incremental value justifies its cost.

frontier.status: archived project merged into Lean core
frontier.summary: README directs users to Lean v4.35.0 lake comparator and lake check for maintained security/performance. Under stated trust and sandbox assumptions, Comparator checks matching theorem statements, allowed axioms and kernel acceptance. It warns that open definition holes can satisfy type/proof checks while evading the intended question and require additional semantic checking.
frontier.accessible: Public verifier specifications and core migration guidance.
frontier.conditional: No proof or sandbox run was performed here. Formal verification does not establish the customer specification, empirical applicability, novelty or economic value.

frontier.summary: Lean tracks proof axiom dependencies. Adding inconsistent axioms can undermine arbitrary proofs; kernel acceptance must be interpreted relative to the axiom inventory.
frontier.conditional: A passed compile alone is insufficient evidence for an intended theorem or operational system.

synthesis.what_changed: By Oct26, current public models and evolutionary coding products make tool-grounded construction, computer use and explicit evaluator loops increasingly accessible at published low token rates. Public research artifacts also expose more checkable scientific output. This changes the feasibility of bounded constructive campaigns; it does not settle domain reliability or market economics.
synthesis.constructive_system: Use reasoning to propose a consequential outcome and diagnose its constraint; software/solver tools to construct the missing instrument; an independent algorithm or check to reject bad artifacts; persistent history to retain scope, failures and costs; business policies to select among real alternatives within the simulated market.
synthesis.available_now: The enabled session supplies frontier reasoning, tools, source inspection, local code execution and team delegation under existing authorization. Public documentation prices can support explicitly modeled costs. No paid API, customer outreach, financial transaction or new commitment was made by this research.
conditional_branches: Unreleased scientific discovery model: inaccessible, never a base-case capability.
New paid model/API or AlphaEvolve access: only a conditional branch, no authority to purchase or call.
Physical laboratory/manufacturing: cannot be claimed from software artifacts; requires lawful autonomous resources and fresh empirical qualification.
General beyond-human foresight: ambition only; current result must name bounded task, comparator and evidence.
canon_constraints: A completed opportunity form is a hypothesis record, not proof of a transformation.
Technical parity can coexist with useful profitable delivery; compare complete costs and buyer choice separately.
A successor can inherit executable means and history, while current acceptance and authority remain fresh.
Recorded counted work, model benchmark cost or mock-token settlement cannot supply missing complete financial evidence.
Retain historical paper results and source boundaries unchanged; a new source run receives its own campaign identity.
